book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Diyon wana Leleli

content: Sipi ali Tomatahikan Waiwaisana
Yeisu i ba, “Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, henala ebo nige ni uulutuka sipi ali gana ana nog elana, yaa gana ni mwena likaan ge ni tuk, iya tokaoma ge toaluoyaoya.
Yaa toto ebo ni ulutuka nog elana, iya sipi ali tomatahikan.
Nog ana tomatahikan nog ni pwela eliyana, yaka ni tuk ge wana sipi alaliya ni lumenil, inoke wana sipi anana nihi hago ge ni nulil tagilagil tola.
Sauga iyaka wana sipi i nulil ge hi tagil tola, inoke iya ni nohouwa ge sipi nihi noulil, kaiwena anana ana gun hi atena.
Sipi nige gamagal getoga nihi nonoulil, yaa nihi lou luwan, kaiwena nige anana ana gun hi aatena.”
Yeisu ba gohalibe ya i baunan Palisi eliyalil, yaa ana sapu nige hi aatena.
Yaka i ba vevehe al i ba, “Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, nau sipi ali gana ana nog.
Bolo hi nem houwa gegewel tokaoma ge toaluoyaoya, inoke analiya sipi nige hi hahago.
He nau nog; henala ebo ni ulutuka elau iya ni mwal. Iya ni tuk ge ni tagil, inoke mwawin waiwaisana ni pwawa.
Tokaoma i nem nige bugul getoga kaiwena i oola, yaa kaoma kaiwena, tagapaaliga kaiwena, ge apapanak kaiwena. Yaa nau ya nem inoke no sipi yawaliliya nihi pwawa, yawal kalakalaopopwina.
“Nau sipi ali tomatahikan waiwaisana. Sipi ali tomatahikan waiwaisana yawalina i talamwan ni yaomal sipi kaiweliya.

Tau toto i tuwalali mola kaiwena, iya nige sipi ali tomatahikan hot i oola, ge nige tonsipi i oola. Sauga ebo ni kite wanuka bekikina i nenem yaka sipi ali en ni pek ge ni lou luwagil, inoke wanuka sipi ni taltalagil ge ni takel pwatpwatagil.
Tau o sipi i lou luwagil, kaiwena i tuwalali mola kaiwena, he nige i nuwanuwatu sipi kaiweliya.
“Nau sipi ali tomatahikan waiwaisana. No sipi ya atenal ge heliya hi atenau,
i ola te Nam i atenau ge nau Nam ya atena. Ge yawaliu ya talamwan na yaomal sipi kaiweliya.
No sipi enuna al hi gan, heliya nige gana ya sipiliyau i oola. Heliya al na ahel ge nihi nem. Anau nihi hago, inoke sipi ali yawi ni maisena ge ali tomatahikan ni maisena.
Nam i nunuwana-agau, kaiwena yawaliu ya talamwan na yaomal—inoke abwe al na ahe pasikal.
Nige gamagal etega bosowaina yawaliu ni pwamowasi, yaa totou te ya talamwan. No gasisi i gan yawaliu na talamwan na yaomal, ge no gasisi i gan na ahe pasikal. O logugui ya aheya Nam elana i ola to.”
Yeisu wana baaba o kaiwena inoke Yudiya boda hi paeluwa al.
Hi gewi hi ba, “Yayaluwa bibikena i ulutuk elana ge i kokona tei. Ga i ola ge wana baaba ku lalaegan-an?”
Yaa enuna hi ba, “Wana baaba nige i oola tau toto yayaluwa bibikena i ulutuk elana. He yayaluwa bibikena bosowaina ya tomatakai mataliya ni abubun ge ni waisi? Nige bosowaina!”
Yudiya Nige Yeisu Hi Aabulilekan
Saugena o tultul ana sauga, ge Yudiya wali tapwalolo hagalena etega i gan Yelusalema, hagali o wali Limi Bwabwalena ana pwabwabwalena nuwahikanina.
He Yeisu iyoho i nawanawa abanawanawa etega Limi Bwabwalena ana gana gamwanaa alana hi ba “Solomon wana Epanapana.”
Yaka Yudiya hi na Yeisu hi mipainan ge hi baek elana hi ba, “Hauna sauga ge abwe nuwama nu ba pasapu? He nu ba bubun naha hago ebo owa Mesaiya o ebo nigeya?”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Iyaka ya ba haba eliyamiu, yaa komiu nige ku aabulilek-an. Ginol yawiyawi bolo Nam alana elana ya ginolil heliya hi pamasalau,
yaa nige ku aabulilek kaiwena komiu nige no sipi i oola.
No sipi anau hi hago ge ya atenal, inoke heliya hi toulilau.
Yawal mihomihotina ya pek elal ge nige nihi yayaomal. He nige gamagal etega bosowaina ni kaluoel nimwau elana.
Heliya Nam i pem elau, ge iya bugul gegewel i bwata lakel. Inoke nige gamagal etega bosowaina ni kaluoel Nam nimanaa.
Nau alou ge Nam ha maisena ya.”
Baaba o kaiwena, inoke Yudiya pat hi pebugul al tage Yeisu nihi loipati.
Yaa Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Ginol waiwaisal hi gewi Nam i pem iyaka ya ginolil ge ku kitel. He hauna toto kaiwena ge nuwamiu nuku loipatagau?”

Yaka anana hi lahe hi ba, “Nige wam ginol waiwaisal etegana kaiwena i oola ge tage naha loipatagiwa, yaa kaiwena u ba bwagabwaga ge Yehoba u hewa likaan. He owa gamagal ya, inoke u ba tage owa Yabowaine!”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Wami Buki Bwabwalena ana leleli etega Yehoba anana i pamasal i ola hiwe: Nau ya ba, ‘Komiu yabowaineyau.’
Yehoba baaba ya i baunan gamagalau elal ge i ba tage heliya yabowaineyau, ge Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba i tunahot sauga gegewena.
Inoke sauga nau ya ba, ‘Nau Yabowaine Natuna,’ he ga i ola ge ku ba tage ya ba bwagabwaga ge Yehoba ya hewa likaan? He nau Nam i hileyau ge i patunau ya nem panayawi.
“Binimala ebo nige Nam wana tuwalali ya giginol, inoke bahi no baaba nuku aabulilek-an.
Yaa wana tuwalali ya awaawaginol, inoke ebo nige no baaba ku aabulilek-an, he no tuwalali o nuku abulilek-an. Inoke nuwamiu ni sapu ge nuku atena te Nam i minaa elau ge nau ya minaa Nam elana.”
Yaka nuwaliya al Yeisu nihi lib ge nihi yowan, yaa hi pihapul ge i noluwagil.
Inoke Yeisu i sikal wewel Yolidani i kalapanet-an, ge i na i miminaa labi toto valila Diyon gamagalau i pababitaisoliya.
Gamagalau hi gewi hi nok elana, ge heliya ya hi baaba hi ola, “Diyon Tobabitaiso nige ginol yawiyawi etega i giginol, yaa baaba gegewena bolo i baunanagil tau ya kaiwena hi tunahot.”
Inoke labi o elana gamagalau hi gewi hi abulilek Yeisu elana.
